messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The team needs to train claims handlers on a new workflow.
  quote: We’re keen to get our claims handlers trained up on the new workflow.
- problem: The customer lacks a solution that effectively manages their claims and supplier reporting.
  quote: Looking forward to seeing how Keelwater handles our claims and supplier reporting needs.
- problem: The customer needs to begin using the claims and document handling system promptly.
  quote: we’re really keen to get started with your system for handling claims and documents
- problem: The customer is unsure how to use claim notes in the platform.
  quote: Hi Bryn, I’m Lirven from Calderwick Commercial — we’ve been using Keelwater for a few months now and I’ve got a quick question about claim notes.
- problem: The customer wants an improvement to how documents are handled in the platform.
  quote: I’ve got a small request around document handling.
- problem: The customer feels their current claims workflow needs improvement.
  quote: We’re eager to see how this improves our claims workflow.
- problem: The team needs a seamless experience when using the claims platform.
  quote: Our team relies on this being seamless.
- problem: The customer lacks effective task tracking for their claims work.
  quote: That’s a welcome update — we’ve been needing better task tracking.
